datasheet_identity.title: US1A THRU US1M SURFACE MOUNT HIGH EFFICIENT RECTIFIER

extraction_notes: Maximum repetitive peak reverse voltage VRRM is 50 V and maximum average forward rectified current IF(AV) is 1.0 A at Ta = 25 degC (p. 1).
Non-repetitive peak forward surge current IFSM is 30 A at t = 8.3 ms half-sine wave (p. 1).
The forward curve is a family curve for US1A-US1D, not a US1A-only trace.
No breakdown characteristic is published for US1A.
